vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.description: Stalwart frontline titan with heavy armor and high health growth.
vanguard.lore: Frontline vanguard legion who stand as unyielding walls of iron and shield.

spellweaver.name: Spellweaver
spellweaver.description: Master of arcane storm and flame, dealing devastating area damage.
spellweaver.lore: Mages of the spellweaver syndicate channeling raw elemental forces to obliterate enemy formations.

shadowblade.name: Shadowblade
shadowblade.description: Lethal rogue specializing in rapid critical hits and high evasion.
shadowblade.lore: Shadowy assassins of the brotherhood, striking unseen from the dark with lethal efficiency.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.description: Devout guardian granting holy protection, healing, and resurrection.
cleric.lore: Holy priests of the Order, weaving sacred blessings and restorative rites for their companions.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.description: Precision sniper firing deadly arrows from afar.
ranger.lore: Wilderness marksmen of the Ranger Corps, wielding composite bows and mechanical traps with lethal precision.

dragoon.name: Dragoon Lancer
dragoon.description: High-flying lancer raining devastating jump strikes and wyvern fire from above.

monk.name: Brawler Monk
monk.description: Fist-fighting brawler executing rapid martial strikes and Asura finishing blows.

paladin.name: Paladin Templar
paladin.description: Golden holy guardian shielding allies with divine aura and sacred radiance.

sage.name: Sage Scholar
sage.description: Master scholar endowing weapons with elemental properties and cancelling magic.

bard.name: Bard Minstrel
bard.description: Charismatic musician serenading party members with offensive and defensive melodies.

alchemist.name: Alchemist Smith
alchemist.description: Eccentric scientist hurling acid bottles and breeding artificial homunculus pets.

bash.name: Bash
bash.description: Strike an enemy with powerful physical force.

provoke_roar.name: Provoke Roar
provoke_roar.description: Bellow a challenge, forcing nearby enemies to target you and lowering their DEF.

shield_bulwark.name: Shield Bulwark
shield_bulwark.description: Plant your shield. Damage taken is reduced by 40% while you hold position.

cleaving_sweep.name: Cleaving Sweep
cleaving_sweep.description: A wide arcing swing that strikes every enemy in front of you.

iron_stance.name: Iron Stance
iron_stance.description: Root yourself in the earth: immune to knockback, +50% DEF, movement halved.

aegis_of_the_legion.name: Aegis of the Legion
aegis_of_the_legion.description: Extend the Legion's oath over your party, granting every ally a damage shield.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: Hurl an exploding ball of fire dealing high elemental damage.

frost_lance.name: Frost Lance
frost_lance.description: Impale a single target on a spear of ice, slowing its movement.

chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain_lightning.description: Loose an arc that leaps between up to four enemies, weakening with each jump.

arcane_siphon.name: Arcane Siphon
arcane_siphon.description: Drain a target's essence, converting a portion of the damage dealt into SP.

mana_shield.name: Mana Shield
mana_shield.description: Spend SP instead of HP for incoming damage until your reserves run dry.

meteor_fall.name: Meteor Fall
meteor_fall.description: Call down burning stone across a wide area. The Spire's signature, stolen.

venom_edge.name: Venom Edge
venom_edge.description: Coat both blades and strike, leaving a wound that bleeds venom over time.

shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
shadow_step.description: Vanish and reappear behind your target, striking before they turn.

fan_of_blades.name: Fan of Blades
fan_of_blades.description: Spin through a crowd, cutting everything within a dagger's reach.

cloak_of_dusk.name: Cloak of Dusk
cloak_of_dusk.description: Fade from sight. Your next strike from concealment is a guaranteed critical.

exploit_weakness.name: Exploit Weakness
exploit_weakness.description: Read the gap in their guard and put a blade through it. Ignores most DEF.

thousand_cuts.name: Thousand Cuts
thousand_cuts.description: An unbroken flurry. Damage scales with how long you remain unhit.

heal.name: Heal
heal.description: Restore target ally's HP based on INT stat.

holy_light.name: Holy Light
holy_light.description: A lance of Aetherite light. Devastating against the returned dead.

sanctuary_ward.name: Sanctuary Ward
sanctuary_ward.description: Consecrate the ground beneath your party, healing all who stand within it.

purge_affliction.name: Purge Affliction
purge_affliction.description: Burn poison, curse, and freeze out of an ally in a single searing moment.

blessing_of_valor.name: Blessing of Valor
blessing_of_valor.description: The Order's oath made manifest: +ATK, +HIT and +MDEF for the whole party.

resurrection_rite.name: Resurrection Rite
resurrection_rite.description: The rite performed in the High Temple, spoken over the fallen where they lie.

piercing_shot.name: Piercing Shot
piercing_shot.description: A drawn-through shot that punches past armour and out the other side.

snare_trap.name: Snare Trap
snare_trap.description: Set a hidden snare. The first thing to cross it is held fast and bleeding.

volley_of_thorns.name: Volley of Thorns
volley_of_thorns.description: Loose a spread of barbed shafts across a cone of ground.

hawk_eye.name: Hawk Eye
hawk_eye.description: Steady the breath and the wind. Greatly increased range, HIT and critical rate.

beast_bond.name: Beast Bond
beast_bond.description: Call the hawk that has been following you since the Corps took you in.

rain_of_arrows.name: Rain of Arrows
rain_of_arrows.description: Empty the quiver skyward. Everything in the marked ground is under it.

dragon_jump.name: Dragon Jump
dragon_jump.description: Leap high into the sky and strike from above with crushing physical force.

wyvern_breath.name: Wyvern Breath
wyvern_breath.description: Exhale dragon fire, scorching all enemies in a cone before you.

asura_strike.name: Asura Strike
asura_strike.description: Channel all remaining spiritual energy into an ultimate fatal punch.

sacred_aegis.name: Sacred Aegis
sacred_aegis.description: Raise a holy shield reducing all incoming damage by 50%.

grand_cross.name: Grand Cross
grand_cross.description: Erupt a massive cross of holy light beneath your feet.

spell_endow.name: Elemental Endow
spell_endow.description: Enchant party weapons with elemental power, boosting party damage.

magic_dispel.name: Magic Dispel
magic_dispel.description: Cancel enemy magical buffs and deal arcane damage.

dissonance.name: Dissonance Song
dissonance.description: Play a harsh chord dealing sonic area damage.

poem_of_bragi.name: Poem of Bragi
poem_of_bragi.description: Play an inspiring anthem reducing party skill cooldowns and cast time.

acid_terror.name: Acid Terror
acid_terror.description: Hurl a bottle of concentrated acid eroding enemy armor.

summon_homunculus.name: Summon Homunculus
summon_homunculus.description: Create an artificial pet companion to fight by your side.

skypierce_thrust.name: Skypierce Thrust
skypierce_thrust.description: Drive a heavy polearm thrust through target defense, ignoring a portion of ARM.

dragon_heart.name: Dragon Heart
dragon_heart.description: Awaken dragon spirit, boosting ATK, Critical rate, and Fire resistance.

comet_dive.name: Comet Dive
comet_dive.description: Plunge from cloud height, creating a fiery shockwave upon impact.

wyrmlord_fury.name: Wyrmlord Fury
wyrmlord_fury.description: Unleash an unbroken series of dragon polearm strikes.

ki_blast.name: Ki Blast
ki_blast.description: Project spiritual energy outward to strike foes from distance.

guillotine_fist.name: Guillotine Strike
guillotine_fist.description: Target vital pressure points with a crushing strike.

body_relocation.name: Body Relocation
body_relocation.description: Instantly step through martial focus, boosting FLEE and movement speed.

zen_meditation.name: Zen Meditation
zen_meditation.description: Enter deep focus, instantly restoring SP and increasing ATK.

shield_boomerang.name: Shield Boomerang
shield_boomerang.description: Hurl your shield at an enemy, scaling damage with defense.

holy_cross.name: Holy Cross
holy_cross.description: Carve a sacred cross into the target with holy energy.

devotion_guard.name: Devotion Guard
devotion_guard.description: Bind party members to your oath, absorbing damage meant for allies.

martyrs_reckoning.name: Martyr's Reckoning
martyrs_reckoning.description: Sacrifice HP to inflict devastating Holy retributive damage.

freecast_bolt.name: Freecast Bolt
freecast_bolt.description: Cast an elemental bolt while moving without casting interruption.

deluge_field.name: Deluge Field
deluge_field.description: Summon a watery field that increases Water magic damage.

spell_breaker.name: Spell Breaker
spell_breaker.description: Shatter casting focus of enemy, absorbing their SP.

volcano_zone.name: Volcano Zone
volcano_zone.description: Transform ground into lava fissures, boosting Fire damage and burning targets.

unruly_melody.name: Unruly Melody
unruly_melody.description: Fire a musical arrow that disorients the enemy target.

frost_joker.name: Frost Joker
frost_joker.description: Tell a joke so terrible it freezes enemies around you.

apple_of_idun.name: Apple of Idun
apple_of_idun.description: Sing a restorative lullaby increasing Max HP and regeneration for all allies.

great_echo.name: Great Echo
great_echo.description: Release a powerful acoustic shockwave reverberating across the battlefield.

potion_pitcher.name: Potion Pitcher
potion_pitcher.description: Toss healing potion brews directly onto an injured ally.

demon_demonstration.name: Demon Demonstration
demon_demonstration.description: Throw a bottle of volatile fuel creating a flaming floor patch.

transmute_gold.name: Transmute Gold
transmute_gold.description: Transmute enemy armor into gold, slowing them and increasing item drop value.

acid_demonstration.name: Acid Demonstration
acid_demonstration.description: Combine acid bomb and fire bottle for an explosive chemical reaction.

sentinel_shield_crash.description: Slam your shield rim into the foe, holding the line with stalwart force.
sentinel_shield_crash.name: Sentinel Shield Crash

granite_oath_edge.description: Channel granite weight into a heavy oath-bound sword cut.
granite_oath_edge.name: Granite Oath Edge

earthen_phalanx_oath.description: Swear an earthen phalanx oath, greatly reducing damage taken.
earthen_phalanx_oath.name: Earthen Phalanx Oath

bulwark_arc_cleave.description: Sweep your blade in a disciplined bulwark arc, cutting all foes ahead.
bulwark_arc_cleave.name: Bulwark Arc Cleave

sanctum_rampart_call.description: Call a radiant sanctum rampart over the party with holy resolve.
sanctum_rampart_call.name: Sanctum Rampart Call

titanfall_breaker.description: Bring down a titanfall overhead blow that splits the earth asunder.
titanfall_breaker.name: Titanfall Breaker

wyrm_vault_strike.description: Vault off your spear shaft for a swift wyrm-fast plunging strike.
wyrm_vault_strike.name: Wyrm Vault Strike

ember_gale_plunge.description: Plunge through the enemy line trailing ember-lit gale winds.
ember_gale_plunge.name: Ember Gale Plunge

stormlance_skewer.description: Fall from high sky with a storm-wreathed lance skewer.
stormlance_skewer.name: Stormlance Skewer

cinderwing_fervor.description: Ignite cinderwing fervor, boosting ATK and fire spirit.
cinderwing_fervor.name: Cinderwing Fervor

cataclysm_comet_crash.description: Crash down like a cataclysm comet, detonating a fiery shockwave.
cataclysm_comet_crash.name: Cataclysm Comet Crash

skysovereign_execution.description: Descend as sky sovereign, executing one blazing draconic judgment.
skysovereign_execution.name: Skysovereign Execution

iron_temple_palm.description: Deliver an iron-temple palm strike honed in mountain training halls.
iron_temple_palm.name: Iron Temple Palm

zephyr_kick_dance.description: Dance through a zephyr-driven spinning kick from temple forms.
zephyr_kick_dance.name: Zephyr Kick Dance

sacred_lotus_fist.description: Bloom sacred lotus ki through your fist with inner holy light.
sacred_lotus_fist.name: Sacred Lotus Fist

mistwalker_ki_flow.description: Flow like mistwalker ki, hastening strikes and evasion on the wind.
mistwalker_ki_flow.name: Mistwalker Ki Flow

tempest_mantra_barrage.description: Chant a tempest mantra and batter all nearby foes with countless palms.
tempest_mantra_barrage.name: Tempest Mantra Barrage

nirvana_king_strike.description: Touch nirvana for an instant and deliver the perfect holy king strike.
nirvana_king_strike.name: Nirvana King Strike

dawn_oath_cut.description: Swear your dawn oath upon the blade and cut with conviction.
dawn_oath_cut.name: Dawn Oath Cut

aegis_rebound_smite.description: Hurl your aegis in a rebounding arc, smiting the foe with steel faith.
aegis_rebound_smite.name: Aegis Rebound Smite

hallowed_bastion_hymn.description: Sing a hallowed bastion hymn, warding the party with blessed steel.
hallowed_bastion_hymn.name: Hallowed Bastion Hymn

retribution_cross_edge.description: Carve retribution into the foe with a searing cross-edged greatsword arc.
retribution_cross_edge.name: Retribution Cross Edge

empyrean_sanctuary_vow.description: Swear an empyrean sanctuary vow, sheltering the party under seraph wings.
empyrean_sanctuary_vow.name: Empyrean Sanctuary Vow

final_martyr_brand.description: Brand the final martyr sigil, erupting holy reckoning over all enemies.
final_martyr_brand.name: Final Martyr Brand

ember_bolt.description: Hurl a compact ember bolt that ignites a single foe with focused flame.
ember_bolt.name: Ember Bolt

gale_needle.description: Launch a screaming needle of compressed air that pierces one enemy and hastens your next cast.
gale_needle.name: Gale Needle

cinder_tide.description: Flood the battlefield with rolling cinders that scorch every enemy in the wave.
cinder_tide.name: Cinder Tide

tidal_spiral.description: Conjure a spiralling waterspout that crashes over all nearby enemies.
tidal_spiral.name: Tidal Spiral

archmage_focus.description: Enter a trance of pure focus, greatly raising magic attack and cast speed for a time.
archmage_focus.name: Archmage Focus

pyroclasm_burst.description: Detonate a cataclysmic eruption of living flame across a vast area.
pyroclasm_burst.name: Pyroclasm Burst

gust_sigil.description: Inscribe a fleeting sigil of wind that fires a sharp gust bolt at one enemy.
gust_sigil.name: Gust Sigil

ward_of_clarity.description: Recite a warding verse that sharpens the party's focus, raising magic defence.
ward_of_clarity.name: Ward of Clarity

updraft_snare.description: Summon a violent updraft that batters all nearby enemies and strips their swiftness.
updraft_snare.name: Updraft Snare

purging_tide.description: Wash an ally in purifying tidewater, dispelling curses, poison and freeze.
purging_tide.name: Purging Tide

grand_lexicon_ward.description: Open the grand lexicon and shield the whole party with layered arcane wards.
grand_lexicon_ward.name: Grand Lexicon Ward

cataclysm_codex.description: Unleash the forbidden final chapter, a howling codex storm that ravages all foes.
cataclysm_codex.name: Cataclysm Codex

minor_restoration.description: Whisper a minor rite that knits an ally's wounds with gentle holy light.
minor_restoration.name: Minor Restoration

searing_supplication.description: Offer a burning prayer that smites a single enemy with consecrated fire.
searing_supplication.name: Searing Supplication

radiant_chorus.description: Lead a radiant chorus that bathes a wounded ally in cascading healing light.
radiant_chorus.name: Radiant Chorus

consecrated_vigil.description: Hold a consecrated vigil over the party, warding all allies with blessed light.
consecrated_vigil.name: Consecrated Vigil

seraphic_aegis.description: Call down seraphic wings over the party, blessing all allies with attack and defence.
seraphic_aegis.name: Seraphic Aegis

judgment_of_dawn.description: Proclaim the dawn's judgment, a pillar of holy wrath that devastates all enemies.
judgment_of_dawn.name: Judgment of Dawn

hymn_of_sparks.description: Strum a crackling hymn that hurls a dart of resonant spark at one enemy.
hymn_of_sparks.name: Hymn of Sparks

soothing_refrain.description: Play a soothing refrain whose soft tide mends a wounded ally's health.
soothing_refrain.name: Soothing Refrain

tempest_ballad.description: Perform a roaring tempest ballad, a gale of sound that strikes all nearby foes.
tempest_ballad.name: Tempest Ballad

cleansing_chorus.description: Sing a cleansing chorus that lifts poison, curse and silence from one ally.
cleansing_chorus.name: Cleansing Chorus

anthem_of_valor.description: Raise an anthem of valour that inspires the whole party with attack and vigour.
anthem_of_valor.name: Anthem of Valor

symphony_of_tides.description: Unleash the grand symphony of tides, a crushing tidal overture over all enemies.
symphony_of_tides.name: Symphony of Tides

gutter_stab.description: Drop low and drive a poisoned blade up under the ribs, then melt back into the scuffle.
gutter_stab.name: Gutter Stab

venom_snare.description: Seed the ground with a venom-coated tripwire. The first enemy to cross it is snared and envenomed.
venom_snare.name: Venom Snare

umbral_crescent.description: Carve a rising crescent of shadow-steel that slices every enemy in front of you.
umbral_crescent.name: Umbral Crescent

serpents_patience.description: Slow your heartbeat and sweat venom onto your blades. Your strikes poison and your next critical hits harder.
serpents_patience.name: Serpent's Patience

widows_kiss.description: A single kiss of the widow's fang to a vital spot. Envenomed targets take grievously increased damage.
widows_kiss.name: Widow's Kiss

eclipse_requiem.description: Blot out the sun with thrown steel. A storm of shadow blades falls on every enemy around you.
eclipse_requiem.name: Eclipse Requiem

double_nock.description: Nock two shafts and loose them in one breath. Both find the same mark before it can move.
double_nock.name: Double Nock

briar_pitfall.description: Dig a thorn-lined pitfall along the game trail. The first enemy across it drops in, bleeding and held.
briar_pitfall.name: Briar Pitfall

splinter_gale.description: Loose a shrieking spread of wind-driven splinters that shreds a cone of ground ahead.
splinter_gale.name: Splinter Gale

alpha_howl.description: Sound the alpha's howl. Your party fights as one pack: faster, keener, and harder to bring down.
alpha_howl.name: Alpha Howl

skysplitter_arrow.description: One arrow, loosed from the edge of sight with the hawk circling above to mark the fall. It splits the sky on the way down.
skysplitter_arrow.name: Skysplitter Arrow

ironwood_downpour.description: Signal the canopy. Ironwood shafts rain down over the marked ground, rooting and ruining everything beneath.
ironwood_downpour.name: Ironwood Downpour

vitriol_flask.description: Hurl a flask of green vitriol that eats through armor and flesh alike.
vitriol_flask.name: Vitriol Flask

soothing_vapors.description: Shatter a soothing phial over an ally, wrapping their wounds in cool, knitting vapors.
soothing_vapors.name: Soothing Vapors

naphtha_bloom.description: Scatter naphtha blossoms that burst into clinging fire across a patch of enemies.
naphtha_bloom.name: Naphtha Bloom

ferrous_elixir.description: Drink down a ferrous brew that plates the blood with iron. Damage taken is blunted and bleeding stops.
ferrous_elixir.name: Ferrous Elixir

pyre_decant.description: Decant a cask of pyre-oil onto one foe and spark it. The fire burns hotter the more it spreads.
pyre_decant.name: Pyre Decant

grand_ignition.description: The masterwork: acid and fire in one vintage. The blast melts armor, then the flames finish the lesson.
grand_ignition.name: Grand Ignition

dustmote_wisp.name: Dustmote Wisp
dustmote_wisp.description: A knot of chaff and sunlight that drifts where the threshing was; harmless until it isn't.

gutter_ratkin.name: Gutter Ratkin
gutter_ratkin.description: Knee-high, wearing a scrap of someone's coin-purse as a hood, entirely unimpressed by you.

thatch_beetle.name: Thatch Beetle
thatch_beetle.description: Fat, iridescent, and eating the roof; the militia pay a copper a shell.

straw_effigy.name: Straw Effigy
straw_effigy.description: A scarecrow that turned to watch you. It burns beautifully, which it seems to know.

gloopling_bellflower.name: Bellflower Gloopling
gloopling_bellflower.description: A pint of blue meadow-water that got ideas; leaves a trail of crushed petals.

bramblehop.name: Bramblehop
bramblehop.description: A hare made mostly of thorn-scrub, and it does not stop bouncing while you fight it.

hornhaste_wasp.name: Hornhaste Wasp
hornhaste_wasp.description: Fist-sized, furious, and always in threes. The Downs' hedgerows hum with them.

snagtooth_raider.name: Snagtooth Raider
snagtooth_raider.description: Wiry, tusked, and armed with whatever the last caravan was carrying. Never travels alone.

mossback_tortin.name: Mossback Tortin
mossback_tortin.description: A shield with legs. Two feet of moss-grown shell that has outlived four generations of raiders.

fen_lurker.name: Fen Lurker
fen_lurker.description: You will see the reeds part before you see the Lurker. That is the only warning offered.

rot_capling.name: Rot Capling
rot_capling.description: A mushroom the size of a child that walks on its own stalk and coughs spores when struck.

snagtooth_warchanter.name: Snagtooth Warchanter
snagtooth_warchanter.description: Beats a shield-totem to a rhythm that makes the whole palisade hit harder. Kill the drum first.

grovewarden_thistle.name: Grovewarden Thistle
grovewarden_thistle.description: The Hollowroot's keeper: a briar-and-antler shape that was standing there before the trees were.

ordwin_palisade_tyrant.name: Ordwin the Palisade Tyrant
ordwin_palisade_tyrant.description: Snagtooth chieftain in stolen Legion plate three sizes too large, and it has not slowed him down once.

drowned_marrowguard.name: Drowned Marrowguard
drowned_marrowguard.description: Still at its post, still in formation, four centuries after the water came in.

pricklespine_thornmarch.name: Thornmarch Pricklespine
pricklespine_thornmarch.description: A bristling green thing that stands perfectly still until it is suddenly somewhere else.

brinemaw_eel.name: Brinemaw Eel
brinemaw_eel.description: Six feet of muscle and hinge-jaw that lives in the flooded pews and considers them home.

silt_creeper.name: Silt Creeper
silt_creeper.description: It looks like sediment until the sediment reaches for your ankle. The Warrens are full of them.

glasslight_mote.name: Glasslight Mote
glasslight_mote.description: A shard of living Aetherite light. Lead three to the braziers and the Reliquary opens.

reliquary_husk.name: Reliquary Husk
reliquary_husk.description: A pilgrim who reached the reliquary, knelt, and never got back up - and then did.

coralbound_acolyte.name: Coralbound Acolyte
coralbound_acolyte.description: Robed, kneeling, and grown through with pink coral. It still tries to finish the rite.

warden_of_the_nave.name: Warden of the Nave
warden_of_the_nave.description: Twelve feet of ceremonial armour full of black water. It patrols the transept on a schedule.

pale_choirmaster.name: The Pale Choirmaster
pale_choirmaster.description: Conducts nothing, in an empty nave, and the Husks all stop moving when it raises its hands.

hallowdeep_warden.name: Hallowdeep, the Choirfall Warden
hallowdeep_warden.description: What the Sanctum was built to contain, wearing the last warden's vestments as an apology.

cinderpuff.name: Cinderpuff
cinderpuff.description: A grinning sphere of contained detonation that drifts closer while you decide what to do.

emberglass_shard.name: Emberglass Shard
emberglass_shard.description: Volcanic glass that cooled into a shape with intent, and edges that have not cooled at all.

ashfall_harrier.name: Ashfall Harrier
ashfall_harrier.description: A raptor that nests in the ash column; you hear the dive a half-second before it lands.

magma_hulk.name: Magma Hulk
magma_hulk.description: Slag given shoulders. Slow, enormous, and it leaves the floor burning where it walked.

soot_revenant.name: Soot Revenant
soot_revenant.description: A foundry-hand who never clocked off, outlined in the shape of the ash that settled on him.

forgewrought_sentinel.name: Forgewrought Sentinel
forgewrought_sentinel.description: Built to guard the Slagworks. Nobody told it the Slagworks ended. It is still guarding.

pyrelash_imp.name: Pyrelash Imp
pyrelash_imp.description: Small, quick, and armed with a whip of live flame it clearly enjoys using.

bellowmaster_grukk.name: Bellowmaster Grukk
bellowmaster_grukk.description: Works the great bellows alone. Every pump makes the crucibles - and the Hulks - flare.

the_unquenched.name: The Unquenched
the_unquenched.description: A fire that has been burning in the Crown's hollow since before the Shattering, and resents interruption.

vashkar_spire_crown.name: Vashkar the Spire Crown
vashkar_spire_crown.description: The mountain's own idea of a king: obsidian, crowned, and molten at every joint.

rimewind_sprite.name: Rimewind Sprite
rimewind_sprite.description: The blizzard, locally. It has a face for as long as you look directly at it.

hoarfrost_stalker.name: Hoarfrost Stalker
hoarfrost_stalker.description: White on white, patient, and it has been pacing you since the second cairn.

frozen_penitent.name: Frozen Penitent
frozen_penitent.description: One of the Statuary. Ice sloughs off it as it remembers how to kneel, then how to stand.

glacier_drake_whelp.name: Glacier Drake Whelp
glacier_drake_whelp.description: Cat-sized, cobalt-scaled, and its breath frosts your armour solid in one pass.

snowveil_shade.name: Snowveil Shade
snowveil_shade.description: A shadow with nothing casting it, sliding between the statues at the edge of the lamp-light.

aurora_seraphon.name: Aurora Seraphon
aurora_seraphon.description: A ribbon of aurora folded into six wings. It circles the Shelf and does not care about you until it does.

permafrost_lich.name: Permafrost Lich
permafrost_lich.description: Vault-keeper, ledger-keeper, and it will tell you exactly which shelf your death goes on.

statuary_colossus.name: Statuary Colossus
statuary_colossus.description: A hero of the old war, thirty feet of them, still frozen and no longer still. Drops the Thawstone.

the_vault_keeper.name: The Vault Keeper
the_vault_keeper.description: It has the only key, and it has been waiting a very long time for someone to ask politely.

sylveth_silent_thaw.name: Sylveth, Queen of the Silent Thaw
sylveth_silent_thaw.description: She stopped the blizzard once, for a heartbeat, and the silence is what people remember.

nethergate_creeper.name: Nethergate Creeper
nethergate_creeper.description: Root-hair braided into a body, walking upside-down along the shaft wall beside you.

weeping_bough.name: Weeping Bough
weeping_bough.description: A branch that hangs low, weeps amber, and closes when something warm passes underneath.

umbral_houndkin.name: Umbral Houndkin
umbral_houndkin.description: Hunts in fours, casts no shadow of its own, and is always closer than it was.

sanguine_thorncaller.name: Sanguine Thorncaller
sanguine_thorncaller.description: Immaculately dressed, seated on the Terrace stair, and will not rise unless you strike first.

hollow_penitent_choir.name: Hollow Penitent Choir
hollow_penitent_choir.description: Nine hollow figures that only move while singing, and only sing while you are looking away.

rootfang_devourer.name: Rootfang Devourer
rootfang_devourer.description: The mouth at the end of the root. There is nothing else to it, and nothing else is needed.

abyssal_heraldon.name: Abyssal Heraldon
abyssal_heraldon.description: The Sovereign's messenger: horned, armoured, and it announces you before it kills you.

thorncradle_warden.name: Thorncradle Warden
thorncradle_warden.description: Honour guard of the briar-bowl, drilled to the second, and it fights three of you at once.

the_pale_apostate.name: The Pale Apostate
the_pale_apostate.description: A Cleric of the High Temple who walked down here on purpose and is still, technically, holy.

verrocaine_sovereign.name: Verrocaine, the Horned Sovereign
verrocaine_sovereign.description: Sovereign of the abyss beneath the world tree. He has been expecting you since Aethelgard was founded.

zones.name: Aethelgard Master Town
zones.description: Central sanctuary of humanity, built as a wheel around the Aetherite Obelisk. Five district wedges and an outer wall with four gates; every district arch is visible from the Obelisk dais.

subRegions.name: Obelisk Plaza
subRegions.description: The Aetherite Obelisk on a raised octagonal dais, ringed by the Grand Fountain's four basins. Respawn anchor, world-map interface, and the loudest recruiting ground in the realm.

subRegions.name: Kestrel Market District
subRegions.description: Awning-shaded lanes of stall rows, the loudest district in the game. Home of the Kestrel Consignment House: storage vaults, teleport service and world maps.

subRegions.name: Ashen Ward
subRegions.description: Soot-black brickwork, chimney smoke and the constant ring of hammers. The Obsidian Smithy and all five class guild halls, each a narrow banner-hung tower.

subRegions.name: The High Temple
subRegions.description: Pale stone and stained glass; the only quiet district. Resurrection rites, blessings, and the Cleric Order's cloister garden.

subRegions.name: Lantern Rows
subRegions.description: Terraced housing under strung paper lanterns, washing lines between the upper storeys. The Elder's House at the top of the Rows opens the main questline; the Rooftop Walk shortcuts to Ashen Ward.

subRegions.name: Wetstone Docks
subRegions.description: Wet flagstones, tide-stained pilings and cargo cranes. The ferry berth to the Sunken Sanctum, The Barnacle tavern, and the unmarked Bilge Steps down to the Silt Warrens.

zones.name: Gatewatch Commons
zones.monsters: Dustmote Wisp, Gutter Ratkin, Thatch Beetle, Straw Effigy
zones.description: Cropped fields and rabbit-fences immediately outside the Rampart Gate, patrolled by bored town militia. Hand-tuned for the first fifteen minutes of play.

subRegions.name: Gatewatch Commons
subRegions.description: Militia Picket, Scarecrow Field and the Broken Fence - the visible gap into Bellflower Downs that tells a new player the world continues that way.

zones.name: Whispering Meadows
zones.monsters: Bellflower Gloopling, Bramblehop, Hornhaste Wasp, Snagtooth Raider, Mossback Tortin, Fen Lurker, Rot Capling
zones.description: Rolling emerald hills that turn to reed and standing water at the northern fen, hemmed by tree lines the Snagtooths patrol.

subRegions.name: Bellflower Downs
subRegions.description: Blue-flowered meadow from the Broken Fence to the first tree line. Gentle, generous and full of sightlines - the area that teaches the camera. Hedgerow herb cluster and the first Save Crystal.

subRegions.name: Windmill Ridge
subRegions.description: A single stone windmill on the realm's highest ground, sails still turning. From the platform you can see the Obelisk south and the Obsidian Spire smoking on the horizon.

subRegions.name: Thistlemarch Fen
subRegions.description: Where the Downs turn to standing water and yellow reed. Slow footing, short sightlines, Fen Lurkers ambushing from the water - the first area that feels genuinely unfriendly.

subRegions.name: Hollowroot Grove
subRegions.description: Entered by walking through the waterfall curtain at the fen's north end; no map marker until you do. A ring of hollow trees around a still pool, and a root-tunnel behind it that drops one-way into the Sunken Sanctum.

subRegions.name: Raider's Palisade
subRegions.description: A Snagtooth war camp of sharpened logs and cook-fires against the eastern tree line. Patrols pull in threes - the realm's difficulty spike and the first content that wants a party.

zones.name: Sunken Sanctum
zones.monsters: Drowned Marrowguard, Thornmarch Pricklespine, Brinemaw Eel, Silt Creeper, Glasslight Mote, Reliquary Husk, Coralbound Acolyte
zones.description: Ancient submerged ruins beneath Aethelgard: bioluminescent turquoise flora, echoing water, and the drowned garrison that never stood down.

subRegions.name: Tidebreak Stair
subRegions.description: A vast spiral of submerged steps descending from the ferry berth, water to the knee and rising as you go. Algae in the stone joints is the only light.

subRegions.name: Silt Warrens
subRegions.description: Silt-cut tunnels the Wetstone smugglers widened into a warehouse: untaxed crates, tallow lamps, and things that got in through the flooded end. The Bilge Steps run straight back to the Docks.

subRegions.name: Drowned Nave
subRegions.description: The cathedral heart of the Sanctum, its vault half-collapsed and open to a column of green water-light. The pews float. The Marrowguard here still keep formation.

subRegions.name: Glasslight Reliquary
subRegions.description: Sealed behind fused Aetherite glass in the north transept; opens when three Glasslight Motes are led into the alcove braziers. Dry, warm and gold-lit - the only dry room in the realm.

subRegions.name: Choirfall Deep
subRegions.description: The lowest chamber, where an underground fall pours endlessly into darkness and the sound of it resolves, if you stand still, into something like singing.

zones.name: Obsidian Spire
zones.monsters: Cinderpuff, Emberglass Shard, Ashfall Harrier, Magma Hulk, Soot Revenant, Forgewrought Sentinel, Pyrelash Imp
zones.description: Volcanic peak crowned with a jagged tower of solid obsidian. Crimson skies, constant ashfall, lava running in cut stone gutters beside the road.

subRegions.name: Cinderfall Approach
subRegions.description: The switchback road up the volcano's flank where the Ashroad caravan drops you. Ash falls constantly and settles on everything; visibility is deliberately reduced.

subRegions.name: Emberglass Terraces
subRegions.description: Stepped shelves where cooling lava sheeted into fields of black volcanic glass. The richest resource area in the game - emberglass, obsidian and fire-salt, densely packed and under-defended on purpose.

subRegions.name: Ashfall Overlook
subRegions.description: A basalt finger above the ash line: clear air above, grey soup below. The whole realm topology is visible, and at night the Glacial Chasm glitters to the east.

subRegions.name: The Slagworks
subRegions.description: Someone built a foundry here and the mountain reclaimed it. Half-melted machinery, crucible pits still glowing, and Sentinels left running with no one to serve.

subRegions.name: Collapsed Skybridge
subRegions.description: A basalt arch that once spanned the caldera, broken in the middle and crossable by a chain of standing pillars. Also the only route from here to the Umbral Rootways.

subRegions.name: The Spire Crown
subRegions.description: The jagged obsidian tower at the summit, hollow, with the whole caldera visible through cracks in its walls.

zones.name: Glacial Chasm
zones.monsters: Rimewind Sprite, Hoarfrost Stalker, Frozen Penitent, Glacier Drake Whelp, Snowveil Shade, Aurora Seraphon, Permafrost Lich
zones.description: Perpetual blizzard canyons where the frozen statues of past heroes stand in ranks and guard the lost vaults behind them.

subRegions.name: Rimewind Pass
subRegions.description: Where the tram line ends: canyon floor under permanent blizzard, wind loud enough to mask footsteps, guide-ropes strung between waypoint cairns.

subRegions.name: Statuary of the Fallen
subRegions.description: Hundreds of ice-encased figures in the poses they died in, ranked down a mile of canyon. Some are recognisable. Some are still moving, very slowly.

subRegions.name: Crevasse Undershelf
subRegions.description: A shelf of blue ice beneath the canyon floor, warmer than the surface and lamp-lit, occupied by the people who run goods over the ice where no tram goes.

subRegions.name: Aurora Shelf
subRegions.description: A wind-scoured plateau above the blizzard line: clear sky, permanent aurora, utter silence. The tonal opposite of everything below it.

subRegions.name: Hoarfrost Vault
subRegions.description: The lost frozen vaults. Sealed doors at the back of the Statuary, opened only by carrying a Thawstone the length of the canyon before it melts.

subRegions.name: Thronehall of Ice
subRegions.description: A natural cathedral of blue ice at the canyon's head, floor polished to a mirror. The stair behind the throne goes down to the Rootways.

zones.name: Umbral Rootways
zones.monsters: Nethergate Creeper, Weeping Bough, Umbral Houndkin, Sanguine Thorncaller, Hollow Penitent Choir, Rootfang Devourer, Abyssal Heraldon
zones.description: The unholy shadow domain beneath the roots of the world tree. Eerie purple twilight, low horns, shifting shadows - and no town portal in. You walk here from the Spire or the Chasm or not at all.

subRegions.name: Nethergate Descent
subRegions.description: Both approach routes converge on a shaft that goes down past the roots of the world tree, lit purple by nothing identifiable. Gravity feels wrong near the walls.

subRegions.name: Bonemeal Hollows
subRegions.description: Chambers where the soil is not soil. Root-hair the thickness of rope hangs from the ceiling and twitches toward warmth.

subRegions.name: The Weeping Boughs
subRegions.description: Enormous downward-growing branches weeping a slow amber sap that is not sap. Poison-saturated: standing still costs HP. The game's only damage-over-time terrain.

subRegions.name: Sanguine Terrace
subRegions.description: A terraced garden, immaculately kept, red-lit, with a table set for eight. Someone maintains it. Entered only by not fighting the Thorncaller that guards the stair.

subRegions.name: Thorncradle Vault
subRegions.description: A briar-walled bowl where the Sovereign's honour guard drills. Everything here is elite-tier and pulls are unforgiving - the last gear check before the throne.

subRegions.name: Throne of the Horned Sovereign
subRegions.description: A chamber of roots grown into the shape of a hall, and at the end of it a throne that was never built.
